action.network.flush-dns.desc: Clears the DNS client cache (Clear-DnsClientCache; otherwise ipconfig /flushdns). Harmless: names are looked up again on next use. Does not change DNS servers.
action.network.renew-ip.desc: Runs ipconfig /renew. The connection drops for a few seconds while DHCP leases are renewed and active VPN sessions may disconnect. Does not change static IPs or settings. Requires administrator; blocked on managed devices.
action.network.reset-winsock.desc: Runs netsh winsock reset (Winsock catalog back to defaults). Requires a Windows RESTART to complete: WinCare never restarts by itself. Can break VPN, proxy or security clients that installed Winsock providers (they may need reinstalling). Requests a restore point first when System Protection is on. Requires administrator; blocked on managed devices.
section.network.adapters.note: Status, link speed, IPv4/IPv6 addresses, gateway, DNS servers and DHCP. MAC addresses are not collected.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.ok: All good: gateway, DNS, the Windows HTTP probe (NCSI) and HTTPS answered.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.no-: No network: neither the gateway, DNS nor the internet answered. Check the cable/Wi-Fi.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.dns: DNS problem: the local network answers but names do not resolve.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.cap: The HTTP probe got a different answer: likely a sign-in portal (hotel, airport) or an intercepting proxy. Open the browser and sign in to the network.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.pro: The proxy requires authentication. WinCare does not send your credentials in these checks; browsers and apps may work normally.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.int: DNS works but the internet (HTTP/HTTPS) did not answer: check the proxy, the network firewall or the provider.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.gat: Only the gateway ping failed; everything else works. Many routers block ping: probably not a problem.
section.network.connectivity.verdict.par: Some checks failed. See the details of each one.
section.network.proxy.note: WinHTTP proxy (Windows services) and the user's proxy (WinINet, browsers). Credentials are masked. Read-only: WinCare does not change proxy settings.
section.network.vpn.note: Information only: Windows VPN profiles and adapters that look like VPN adapters. WinCare never changes VPN.
